resourceBoundary.policy: Complete requests and replies remain bounded at 4096 bytes; no chunked command or optimistic publication.

semantics: Revision-pinned native vertex and tangent intents on editable vector paths. Optional atFrame promotes a held vector-only cell and copies its siblings before editing, preserving the source key; identity geometry still creates that key. A tangent pairedPoint retains the last mirrored endpoint when Alt is pressed during a drag; it is valid only with breakPair. Other identity edits preserve bytes and history. One atomic transaction and one undo entry. Detached paged geometry and preview use query.document.object with the closed subselect selector and retain the source target identity. Plain pressure ribbons expose open editable centerSegments while preserving surviving widths, widthProfile, strokeProfile and profileBase; their presented items add paintCount (2..256). Optional subselect.paint:true reads the closed painted outline with the same bounded paging and an exact paint:true response marker, correlated to the request and presentation; false is invalid. Painted geometry drives object hit-testing; a hit-test listing item also carries role and a required boolean filled (the record has solid or gradient fill paint), so an interior click hits a filled closed record but not an unfilled outline, and a brush texture's anchor, one of its stamped copies or a bitmap brush's anchor names itself in the optional brush member (anchor, copy, bitmap) with the optional group id they share, so Select can resolve a copy to its anchor; the listing also carries the layer's raster images and text blocks (roles raster and text, count 0, bounds the item's stored rect or glyph box in its own frame, matrix the map from that frame to the painted rect or glyph box: the display rotation and the layer's parent chain; a batch matrix reshape of such an item is in that frame) at their paint-order position, with no geometry page, while center geometry supplies handles and insertion indices. A hit-test listing item may also carry style (#2372: hex fill and stroke, width, opacity, and the stroke details cap, join, miter, dashOffset and paintOrder, and the stored two-stop fillGradient; an image its opacity, a text block its colour and the colour alpha) for the right panel, and a dynamic rectangle, ellipse or star its paramShape (#2372: the kind and the finite members that kind owns, never the generator box; the body object.parametric.set takes back) for the Rounded corners, Ellipse arc and Star panels. Pressure insertion, linked fills, textured/bitmap pressure and Fill Brush remain unavailable. Unsupported geometry consumers return unavailable; no JavaScript or Paper writer fallback. The hit-test listing and hit-test geometry of an ENTERED declared component (#2256, the context the viewport presents) answer like the scene's, with that component's own layers and records; the answer names the presented context, and the editable Subselect listing, preview and edit stay on the scene root. Installed acceptance remains pending.
